Internal helper: clean.names = TRUE for an example save that needs it

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_example_clean_names.Rd

Session 389 (Fix Slate 28; the (S388) item). The example jsave() lines jsave()'s stops offer – the no-filename stop's, the front-door stops' (.jst_jsave_example_lines()), the no-data-frame stop's (.jst_jsave_no_frame_stop()) – name a data frame and a file. When the data frame holds a name the file's format refuses, the line as printed stopped on that name (jsave(d, "mydata.sav") for a d holding a variable named with, which SPSS reserves): a remedy that leads to another stop (ruling R23). Such a line carries clean.names = TRUE, as the save that closes jsave()'s own stop does since ruling R33.

Usage

.jst_example_clean_names(df, file)

Arguments

df

The data frame the line saves, or NULL when the line names a placeholder.

file

Character(1); the file the line names.

Value

", clean.names = TRUE", or "" when the format takes every name (or there is no data frame to read).
